description: A most general unifier \(\mu\) of a finite actual atom family unifies it, and every unifier \(\sigma\) into any residual variable alphabet in the chosen universe satisfies \(\sigma(x)=\mu(x)\rho\) for some single \(\rho\) and every variable \(x\).
